title: Google DeepMind's Logan Kilpatrick on Why AGI Won't Be a Model
description:
AGI is not just a model—it's a product someone will create. In a rapidly evolving AI landscape, developers must adapt to achieve top-tier productivity gains. The rules are rewritten constantly, and static knowledge isn't enough. Stay on top, or risk being left behind. It sounds daunting. It still works. 

Logan Kilpatrick, a Group Product Manager at Google DeepMind, draws from his deep experience at OpenAI with Sam Altman. At Google DeepMind, he leads efforts to turn research into tangible products, building platforms that weave AI models into usable tools. Kilpatrick provides insights into the dynamic AI ecosystem, sharing what developers need to thrive amid constant change.

What we cover:
• Why AGI will be a product, not a model
• How will development tools converge or remain fragmented?
• The continuous change in how AI tools are used
• The transformation happening within the Gemini team
• There will be 100x more developers as a result of AI
